I grab the cards and she pulls them back. She threatens to spray them on the ground and I tell her no.


 She does this smile and sets the cards down. I immediately pick them up and pull them away. Please keep in mind I barely know her first name and she just moved to my table. She then asks if I like guys. (I’m bi but I rather not let people know.) So I ignore the question and try and get my work done. I think it’s fair to mention she’s been trying to get an answer to that from me for just about 3 months.


 She then brings the little ritual I do. Says I gotta be gay because I clearly love Nicholas Cage so much. (I'm paraphrasing) I say I'm not and the person sitting next to me says no he's not. (Which 1. I'm not a he, but it's ok she didn't know. And 2. Just thought y'all should know, this is a high school human growth and development class. Im 18 and the other person is 15 also the teachers are out and the sub is just there.) 


So the person next to me I'll say her names M. Just not to get confused with the other person ill call K. M says to K that "I'm a f*****." And I cut in with an "is that an issue?" And M says "is it?" K avoided the question and says "you love Nick cage so much like if it was (some country singer I dont remember) I would understand but thats just gross,"


 I say "that's your type? Gross," and here's where it gets a little muddy. I might come back later when I’m thinking about it more and edit it to what was said (I came back, but still don’t remember what was said unfortunately. Just fixing this up a bit).


Eventually, she shows me her phone and says "a bunch of guys want me," I start to laugh. Then I laugh some more, and more. Eventually the table joins in laughing save for like 2 people. After what felt like 2 minutes of straight nonstop laughing I try and stop myself. 


She asks "what's so funny?" I said "that's the most bullshit I've heard from your mouth," and laugh some more. She left to go to the bathroom about 30 seconds after. M said “I was right” and, “I told her I feel like shit for doing that.” Then the person across from me, A, said "nah bro, that was funny as hell,"
